story_text:
Bare Tool + 3 Nozzles + Suction Cup + Vacuum Bags in one kit. $5 cheaper than buying apart!
As standard, a Safety Net comes fitted on every GPX, one per tool.Now that we've reached the stretch goal, we're adding one spare Safety Net for every backer as a thank-you.
Introducing AirCannon GPX: a handheld blower that hits 118mph(190km/h), squeezed into the most compact body in its class. Maximum power, minimum size: one hand is all it takes to clear your path. Gale-Force Power, Times X. The AirCannon is back, now as the GPX series.
## HIGHLIGHTS
A legend didn’t just burst onto the scene, it practically blew the doors off Kickstarter. The original AirCannon became #1 because it was the powerful, portable beast you knew you needed, but could never find. The legend has hit the gym. Hard.
## 140,000rpm Makes 118mph
How do you hold a Category 3 hurricane in the your hand? Simple: 140,000 RPM. This isn’t a marketing puff piece; it’s raw physics... We’re not exaggerating; we're just engineered better.
GPX pushes with 2.4lb(1.1kg) of force. That is a dumbbell's worth of weight, lifted by nothing but air. Point it at a full tank of water. Gone in an instant.
You love comparing CFM, right? Let’s play. Your average, clunky backyard leaf blower kicks out around 230–250 CFM. Now, The GPX. At just 7.8 inches (198mm) long, it generates a comparable 237 CFM. We ditched the bulk but kept the grunt.
## Aviation DNA Powerful Motor
For stronger, more precise airflow, GPX is built on aviation motor technology: high output for liftoff, sustained efficiency for long flights, and bulletproof durability in extreme conditions. All three, now packed into one tool with Jet-Force Wind.
GPX's blade is forged from zinc-aluminum alloy, hard enough to slice through the air instead of pushing it. That is where the sharp, focused airflow comes from. Corrosion-resistant, heat-resistant, high-strength: it won't bend, and it won't break.
Unwavering Power. Power that fades in seconds is strictly for amateurs. GPX uses high-thermal-conductivity alloy to dissipate heat the moment it builds, keeping temperature stable throughout.
The ESC (Electronic Speed Controller) regulates high voltage and current with precision, preventing overload during extended use. Max power for a full 30 seconds is not a lucky streak. It is engineered.
The science behind the storm: the Triple Vane System. Three layers work as one. A 6-vane stator and a 5-vane stator flank the blade on both sides, and their staggered vanes converge incoming air into a single, focused Dual-Helix stream with no dispersion and no waste. The blade then drives that stream forward with force: over 2x the output of a single-rotor design, enough to clear leaves and standing water in one pass.
Lighter than comparable blowers
Weighing in at a 0.77lbs (0.35kg), GPX is 43% lighter than the bulky alternatives. Carry it all day, clean the whole yard, and your arm won't even notice. Zero wrist drag.
## Shape The Air With 3 Nozzles
Blast it. Pinpoint it. Vacuum it.
Three nozzles, three jobs, all included. Each one reshapes GPX's airflow with serious aerodynamics, squeezing even more power out of that 118mph engine.
With the Boost Nozzle on, you get 25% more power, enough to leave your pickup spotless and blow off every drop in seconds, scratch-free. Tired of towel-drying by hand because your old blower can't keep up? GPX has the muscle to keep your ride looking flawless.
The Detail Nozzle hides a secret: a bullet-shaped centerbody narrows the airflow channel, accelerating the air and creating a pressure differential that pulls it toward the center. Cross-section narrowed by 66%. Fired like an arrow. Hits like a critical hit.
Your PC works hard under a layer of dust while you're hunting for a new AI model. Give your workhorse the cleanup it's earned. The Detail Nozzle's pinpoint airflow reaches every corner, bringing your rig back to factory-fresh. Aim. Fire.
GPX doesn't just push air. It pulls it in, and like a real hurricane, it pulls you in when you get too close. The Vacuum Nozzle draws in dust at up to 12,000Pa of suction pressure.
Inside the Vacuum Nozzle: a HEPA filter that traps 99.97% of particles down to 0.3 microns. From large debris to fine dust, it's sucked in and locked in. Keep your space spotless.
Most blowers make you flip the entire unit around, grip and all, just to switch to suction. GPX solves it with instant reverse rotation: one button reverses the motor and you're in suction mode.
Switch from Suction Mode to Blower Mode in 1 second. Blast out everything trapped inside.
Use it to clean dust inside your car. Need to empty it? Open the lid, flip to Blower Mode, and fire. The hurricane clears itself out. No removing the dust cup, no shaking it out.
## Max 5,000mAh Battery
To maximize runtime, GPX runs on a battery rated up to 5,000 mAh, a full 120 minutes of nonstop power. Drying a full-size SUV takes about 20 minutes. One charge, six cars.
※The 5,000 mAh battery is included in the Pro Rewards only.
Pick Your Pace: Two Battery Options. Grab the 30A (2,500 mAh) battery for ultra-lightweight tasks, the ultimate compact choice for quick jobs and effortless portability.
Big Type, 60A (5,000mAh), for the long haul. Up to 2 hours of runtime: enough to clear a sawdust-covered workshop after a full day of DIY, with charge to spare.
※Battery configuration varies depending on your reward tier.
Dead battery? Swap it. Keep a spare charged, and the moment one runs out, the fresh one goes in and you're back to work in five seconds flat. Your hurricane never gets tired.
## Built Around You
You’d assume this level of power comes with deafening noise. Not with the GPX. Engineered with advanced internal acoustic insulation, it delivers maximum output at a manageable 85dB, on par with a standard hair dryer. Uncompromising performance, zero noise fatigue.
Any USB-C cable. Any power source. That's all GPX needs: a wall charger, a power bank, a laptop, whatever is within reach. No proprietary charger to hunt down, no adapter to forget, just the cable already in your bag. High-speed Type-C charging gets you back to work faster.
※The USB-C port location may change during the development stage.
Control the hurricane with your finger: a gentle squeeze for a soft breeze, a full pull for MAX output, five levels in all. Your current level is on the display.
Time to Go Full Beast Mode. Still not satisfied? Hit Turbo Mode. This instantly pushes every ounce of GPX's output to the max, unleashing a devastating blast for 30 seconds. It’s your ultimate move. (Fair warning: Even ultimate moves need a cooldown.)
Ergonomic and contoured, the grip follows the natural curve of your hand and keeps the weight balanced, so it never drags on your wrist, even hours into a long session. No cramping, no strain. Just control.
A Fortress Built for a Hurricane. Inside, precision custom-fit EVA foam holds every component securely, shielding them from heavy impacts and drop damage. A dual-zipper enclosure adds a tight secondary barrier against dust, engineered for total peace of mind in even the most unforgiving environments. The shock-absorbing exterior shell takes the hits so your gear will be PROTECTED.
GPX slides right in. Compact and lightweight, the case fits your trunk or a cabinet shelf just as easily. Every storm needs an off switch. Tuck GPX away, and it's ready the next time you need it.

faq.q: Is the AirCannon GPX compatible with third-party batteries? (Milwaukee, Bosch, Makita, etc.)
faq.a: The AirCannon GPX runs on its own 16.8V battery system and isn't compatible with other brands' batteries. There's no third-party battery adapter planned for this model.

faq.q: How do I charge the battery?
faq.a: The GPX charges with a TYPE-C cable. No dedicated charger required. It also supports 35W fast charging.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: The 30A (2,500 mAh) battery runs up to 1 hour, and the 60A (5,000 mAh) battery runs up to 2 hours on a single charge.

faq.q: How do I switch between Blow mode and Vacuum mode?
faq.a: There's a side button in the middle of the unit. Push it to the right for Blow mode, and to the left for Vacuum mode. Note: you can't switch modes while air is firing. Always stop the unit before changing modes.

faq.q: How do I use Turbo mode?
faq.a: There's a Turbo button on the display. Press and hold it for 1 second to activate Turbo mode. Once active, the air keeps firing even without holding down the trigger.

faq.q: Won't debris get into the motor during vacuum mode?
faq.a: To prevent that, we include a dedicated HEPA filter. It's densely and thickly built, filtering particles as small as 0.3 microns. One filter is included in every reward, and additional filters are available as add-ons.

faq.q: Can I store batteries inside the case?
faq.a: Yes, you can. There's a zippered pocket on the inside of the case lid. Just unzip it to store your batteries and small accessories, no matter which battery type you choose.

faq.q: How is the product shipped if I don't purchase the case?
faq.a: Your GPX ships in a sturdy carton box with custom-fit soft foam. The foam holds the product in place, and it won't get scratched even if it shifts.

faq.q: Is the motor guard (Intake Guard) part of the basic set?
faq.a: It's not included in the basic set. However, if we hit our $200,000 stretch goal, we'll give it to every Backer for free as a gift. It's also available as an add-on.

faq.q: Is it safe to use on my PC or electronics?
faq.a: Yes, but when cleaning PC fans, hold the fan blades in place. Spinning fans with high-pressure air can generate back-EMF and potentially damage components.

faq.q: The original AirCannon was a Kikaito product. Why is its successor, the AirCannon GPX, a Magpie product?
faq.a: Both products are manufactured by Kikaito, and were co-developed together by Magpie and Kikaito. This time, by mutual agreement, the GPX launches under our name "MAGPIE" in recognition of the significant role we played in its joint development. Kikaito remains the manufacturer, while Magpie is the product's brand.
